messages.subject: modifying smooths
parts:
I would like to produce a graph similar to the attached one, except that everything, residuals, smooth fit and CI to the right of 0 ( the blue vertical line) are all moved up so that the dashed red line is through 0.  The original plot is generated with the following code:

 plot(C2A.bam8, main = "C2A.bam8",residuals = TRUE, shade=TRUE)
  abline(h = 0,col=2,lty=1)
  abline(h= -1*C2A.bam8$coefficients[12], col =2, lty =2)
  #the dashed red line is the new "zero" for the residules of ppl who took
  #P7A prior i.e. subtract of the contribution of the P7APrior=1 contribution(rel to =-1)
  abline(v = 0,col=4,lty=1)

where C2A.bam8 is a the result of a gam() call, and the $coefficients[c(11,12)] are for a factor that is the sign of the Yfrm7A (x-axis).  That is the 12th coefficient is the effect of having a positive Yfrm7A

Thanks
Robert
